title: Data Warehouse Migration
summary: Consolidating financial data behind one API.
challenge: Financial data lived in an ageing warehouse on SQL Server and Microgen, and every team that needed it had to reach into several databases separately.
built: We migrated the warehouse to PostgreSQL and built a Data Access Manager that exposes multiple databases through a single API, so applications ask one place for the data they need.
impact: One trusted access point means fewer one-off integrations, consistent data across the organisation and a platform that is easier to maintain and extend.
imageAlt: Rows of server racks lit in teal in a data centre

title: Cross-Border Monitoring
summary: Tracking activity across political boundaries with satellite and geodata.
challenge: Illegal activity does not stop at political boundaries, and the people tracking it needed one picture built from imagery and map data held by different providers.
built: A geospatial monitoring system that brings together satellite and geodata from Google, Planet.com and OpenStreetMap, so activity can be followed across territory and boundaries.
impact: Monitoring teams work from one consistent view of the ground instead of piecing sources together by hand.
imageAlt: Earth seen from space with Africa in view

title: Distributed Balance Computation
summary: Computing balances and notifications for millions — automated or on demand.
challenge: Balances had to be computed and customers notified across millions of records, on a schedule and on demand, without one slow job holding up the rest.
built: A distributed system that splits balance computation across workers and sends notifications to millions of customers, run automatically or triggered on demand.
impact: Customers hear about their balances reliably, and the institution can run the process whenever it needs to without waiting on a single machine.

title: Real-Time ID Verification
summary: Validating identity across passport, license, and national ID records.
challenge: Onboarding and compliance teams needed to confirm who a person is against more than one official source, quickly and in the moment.
built: A multi-source identity verification system that validates details in real time against Passport, Driver's License and SSNIT records.
impact: Identity checks happen during onboarding rather than days later, with every source checked through one process.
